candidates.message: Isolate each row in a savepoint while preserving the caller’s transaction.

signal.rationale: Each row is flushed inside its own savepoint, and only row-level IntegrityError failures are rejected; begin_nested runs outside the handler so failures flushing the caller’s pending changes propagate. Explicitly starting SQLite’s physical transaction when needed ensures releasing savepoints cannot prevent a later caller rollback from undoing successful inserts.
